wire_envelope: unchanged ghost-lifetime/1; no model-selected worker address

operator_configuration.routes: current compute routes validated against the exact Ghost, Home, runtime, model and capability grant
operator_configuration.cleanup_origins: optional explicit historical Ghost/computer/worker_root/worker_socket records; existing Host home provenance required; no bind, reactivation or fresh compute grant

host_metadata: immutable native_worker_origin:<computer_id> records in workspace_objects/meta; a changed owner/root/socket is a conflict, never an automatic replacement
routing: Fresh submit follows the exact admitted WorkerSpec.computer_id, not a guessed address.
Inspect/observe and historical control resolve the exact successful committed work.submit for this Work, execution and owner to its original computer, then its immutable worker origin.
Missing, rejected, foreign or ambiguous original submit provenance never falls back to the Ghost's current worker.
Historical cleanup authority does not permit steer unless that execution still belongs to the current compute route.
Cancellation can reach an original retired route without reactivating its Home or moving its execution identity. Worker original epoch, process, tool-effect and cleanup fences remain authoritative.
Unreachable original endpoints retain unresolved facts; no replacement execution, implicit home migration, SDK completion or acceptance is synthesized.
restore: metadata and original command receipts belong to the stopped consistent Host bundle. Dispatch-off restore does not provision workers or rewrite original paths. Explicit relocation/quarantine reconciliation remains required before dispatch.
acceptance: Source and isolated route tests are not cold multi-root restore, mini cutover or product acceptance. Root must exercise actual original-worker and fresh native flows.
